columns.name: id
columns.description: Surrogate primary key for the stock record.

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Product SKU; part of the addressing key (PI2 NOT NULL, PI1 unique with location).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Storage location; part of the addressing key (PI2 NOT NULL, PI1 unique with sku).

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Inventory classification code carried by every filed record (PI2 NOT NULL).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stored stock level; NOT NULL (PI2) and constrained non-negative (PI3).

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Identity that filed the record/adjustment; retained for the audit invariant (NFR-F1-1).

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Immutable creation timestamp preserved across additive migrations (NFR-F1-1).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent upsert write for the (sku, location) pair.

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with columns id (uuid PK, default gen_random_uuid()), sku, location, inventory_code, quantity (all NOT NULL), actor NOT NULL, created_at/updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL default now(); composite UNIQUE (sku, location) realized via the unique index uq_stock_records_sku_location; CHECK (quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive create-table migration with a working downgrade (DROP TABLE stock_records). Fully reversible and preserves any pre-existing records (PI5, NFR-F1-1). The (sku, location) unique index backs the write-time upsert (PI1/PI4); the service performs read-existing-then-write inside a single transaction so a concurrent repeat file collapses to one row rather than storing a duplicate.
